apps.name: OpenGothic MetalFX Temporal
apps.subtitle: Recommended high-quality iOS build
apps.localizedDescription: OpenGothic for iPhone and iPad with MetalFX Temporal reconstruction, automatic MetalFX Spatial and Lanczos fallback, touch controls and physical-controller support. Requires legally owned Gothic II: Night of the Raven game data; no game assets are included.
apps.versionDescription: OpenGothic iOS 1.3.0 based on current Try/OpenGothic and Try/Tempest, with MetalFX Temporal, four-direction touch D-pad, complete touch controls and automatic renderer fallback.
